criteria.description: Facts, definitions and numbers are correct; no invented sources.
Standard Arabic technical terms are used instead of unnecessary transliteration or wrong terms.
Grammar, spelling, fluency and the requested register (Modern Standard Arabic unless told otherwise).
Follows the request: language, count, length and format.
Arabic punctuation, consistent numerals, correct handling of mixed Arabic/Latin text.

gates.reason: A wrong core fact cannot be offset by good language.
Ignoring an explicit instruction caps the score.
Serious language problems cap the score.
An invented source is the most damaging error.

scale_guide.5: Excellent: accurate, natural and correctly formatted
